name: AI Resume Builder
description: AI-powered resume builder that creates professional resumes in minutes. Features include smart formatting, keyword optimization for ATS systems, multiple templates, and one-tap export to PDF.
description_cn: AI 驱动的简历生成工具，支持智能排版、ATS 关键词优化、多模板选择、一键导出 PDF。

name: AI Photo Enhancer
description: Enhance photos with AI: upscale resolution, remove noise, fix lighting, restore old photos, and remove backgrounds automatically.
description_cn: AI 图片增强：超分辨率、降噪、光线修复、老照片修复、自动抠图。

name: Language Learning Coach
description: AI conversation partner for language learning. Practice speaking with AI tutors, get pronunciation feedback, learn vocabulary in context, and track progress.
description_cn: AI 语言学习对话伙伴，支持口语练习、发音纠正、场景化词汇学习、学习进度追踪。

name: Smart Meal Planner
description: AI-generated meal plans based on dietary preferences, allergies, and fitness goals. Automatic grocery lists and nutritional tracking.
description_cn: 根据饮食偏好、过敏源和健身目标生成 AI 餐饮计划，自动生成购物清单和营养追踪。

name: AI Writing Assistant
description: AI writing companion for essays, emails, social posts, and creative writing. Grammar correction, tone adjustment, translation, and text summarization.
description_cn: AI 写作伙伴，支持文章、邮件、社交帖子和创意写作，提供语法纠正、语气调整、翻译和文本摘要。
